title: 50k nucleosome foot-printing
body:
### 1. Quantification of lig50k nuc. recon. sample

Qubit reading = 3.1 ng/uL
Nanodrop reading = 14 ng/uL

*NOTE: The latter reading indicates ~700 ng of total DNA yield*

### 2. Preparation of new *Hia5* buffer

Hia5 Buffer (10 mL)

| Reagent | Volume |
| :---- | :---- |
|1 M Tris pH 8 |	150 uL |
|EDTA (0.5 M) |	20 uL |
| EGTA (0.5 M) |	10 uL |
| NaCl (100 mM) |	1500 uL |
| KCl (100 mM) |	6000 uL |

Filter the buffer prior to usage.

*NOTE: Add spermidine and SAM prior to usage*
experiments: 1. Quantification of lig50k nuc. recon. sample
